name: a-command-naming-a-script-in-a-keel-installation-is-not-judged-by-it
description: T506/BL57, the owner's case end to end: a session in a project that has NOT adopted keel runs keel's own CLI out of the installed tree - the documented first step of laying keel. The installation is a whole copy of this repository, armed at tier 2 by the .keel/keel-policy.md an install carries, and before this guard it governed the command and refused it with 'no fresh plan for THIS session', naming the plugin cache as the governing project and a ledger inside it as the remedy. An installation is never a governing project, so nothing governs this command and it runs. HOME and USERPROFILE point at a throwaway directory inside the fixture's own temporary tree, so the real plugin cache is never read.
